## Monday

*Methods: trees and forests*

### Required reading

- Wager and Athey (2018), [*Estimation and inference of heterogeneous treatment effects using random forests*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.04342).

### Optional / reference

- Athey and Imbens (2016), [*Recursive partitioning for heterogeneous causal effects*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.01132).
- Athey, Tibshirani, and Wager (2019), [*Generalized random forests*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.01271).

### Required reading

- Künzel et al. (2019), [*Metalearners for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects using machine learning*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03461).
